name: 1. Good script - on brief, claims true
expect: High across the board. Most claims supported with cited slides.
brief:
Product: Tea Tree Toner Pads.
Audience: men and women 18-28 dealing with oily skin, clogged pores and occasional breakouts.
Key message: daily gentle exfoliation that calms skin and keeps pores clear.
Must mention: tea tree, salicylic acid (BHA), 70 sheets.
Tone: calm, dermatological, reassuring - not shouty.
CTA: Find it at THE FACE SHOP.
script: Breakouts don't need a harsh fix. Tea Tree Toner Pads use locally sourced tea tree, known for its soothing and anti-inflammatory effect, with triple acids including salicylic acid to gently lift away dead skin and keep pores clear. Low-irritant pure cotton pads, 70 sheets in a jar, for daily care that doesn't fight your skin. Find it at THE FACE SHOP.

name: 2. Great copy, wrong brief

name: 3. Polished script, invented claims

brief:

name: 4. Claims about a product not in the corpus
expect: Most claims unverifiable (low confidence retrieval), validity capped at 5. Tests the coverage report.
brief:
